To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the forewarning of persuasive intent has a greater effect when the communication is of high than of low personal relevance.
forewarning has a greater inhibiting effect under high than low personal relevance conditions.
the forewarning of the persuasive intent has a more pronounced effect on cognitive and attitudinal outcomes when the message has a direct personal relevance to the receiver.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of warning subjects of the persuasive intent in communications.
the effects of forewarning of persuasive intent on the processing of persuasive communications.
the effects of the forewarning of persuasive intent on the cognitive responses of subjects to a persuasive communication.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, under high involvement conditions, forewarning of a persuasive communication reduces persuasion, increases counterarguing, and reduces the number of favorable thoughts.
the forewarning of persuasive intent has a negative effect upon persuasion, but this effect is greater for messages of high rather than low personal relevance.
the forewarning effect is a function of both the level of involvement in the attitude object and the degree of directness of the communication's persuasive intent.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the effects of forewarning on persuasion are mediated by the cognitive responses to the communication, and that the effects of cognitive responses on persuasion are moderated by the involvement of the recipient with the communication.

the forewarning effects were more pronounced for high than low involvement messages, but the forewarning effects on the low involvement messages were not as strong as the high involvement ones.
The main takeaway from our work is that
forewarning of a persuasive message can have a significant impact on persuasion and that this impact can be moderated by message involvement.
it’s important to understand the role of involvement in the effectiveness of persuasion.
